text: 升级编辑已全部落地（鬼影光斑、两个新渐变、逐条光束呼吸、光束热芯、草地光斑）。现在重跑语法校验与结构/运动学校验，并用无头 Chrome 渲染新光效的三个时间相位截图。

arguments.command: $html = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'E:\DSH套娃测试\pelican-spring-ride.html'; $m = [regex]::Match($html, '(?s)<script>(.*?)</script>'); $src = $m.Groups[1].Value; Write-Output ('script chars: ' + $src.Length); $src | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8');process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{try{new (require('vm').Script)(s);console.log('syntax OK, chars='+s.length)}catch(e){console.log('SYNTAX ERROR: '+e.message);process.exitCode=1}})"; Write-Output ('node exit: ' + $LASTEXITCODE); Write-Output '--- structure ---'; node 'E:\DSH套娃测试\.patch-work\pelican\structure-check.mjs'; Write-Output ('structure exit: ' + $LASTEXITCODE); Write-Output '--- kinematics ---'; node 'E:\DSH套娃测试\.patch-work\pelican\kinematics-check.mjs'; Write-Output ('kinematics exit: ' + $LASTEXITCODE)

$chrome='C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'; $prof='E:\DSH套娃测试\pelican-work\chrome-prof3'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $prof | Out-Null; $url='file:///E:/DSH%E5%A5%97%E5%A8%83%E6%B5%8B%E8%AF%95/pelican-spring-ride.html'; foreach($b in 900,1800,3400){ $png = 'E:\DSH套娃测试\pelican-work\gh-' + $b + '.png'; if(Test-Path $png){Remove-Item $png -Force}; & $chrome --headless=new --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --disable-breakpad --disable-crash-reporter --disable-extensions --no-first-run --user-data-dir=$prof --hide-scrollbars --force-device-scale-factor=1 --window-size=1280,760 --virtual-time-budget=$b --screenshot=$png $url 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 2; if(Test-Path $png){ Write-Output ('gh-' + $b + ' : ' + (Get-Item $png).Length + ' bytes') } else { Write-Output ('gh-' + $b + ' : MISSING') } }
arguments.description: Render upgraded light FX at three phases
arguments.justification: Chrome 在本会话已多次因沙箱拒绝其 crashpad/mojo 进程通道（0x5）而无法渲染，需要更宽权限才能生成升级后光效的验证截图。
